text_markup: The act of paying a cost cannot be modified or cancelled by optional interrupt abilities.
text_plain: The act of paying a cost cannot be modified or cancelled by optional interrupt abilities.

examples.text_markup: The Runner can trash {card:Clone Chip} to trigger its paid ability, but cannot use {card:LLDS Energy Regulator} to prevent {card:Clone Chip} from being trashed this way.
examples.text_plain: The Runner can trash Clone Chip to trigger its paid ability, but cannot use LLDS Energy Regulator to prevent Clone Chip from being trashed this way.
